name: Blue Square Real Estate Ltd
summary: Blue Square Real Estate Ltd provides real estate services in Israel. It leases commercial spaces, including shopping centers and small retail complexes, logistics, and offices. The company also offers innovation, development, and improvement of commercial properties, shopping malls, logistics centers, and office towers, as well as undertakes residential, mixed-use, and urban renewal and projects. In addition, it provides It offers residential construction services. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Tel Aviv-Yafo, Israel. Blue Square Real Estate Ltd is a subsidiary of Alon Blue Square Israel Ltd.
